records.description_raw: Exchange price + margin If you steer your electricity consumption and want to benefit from it as much as possible. Exchange price updated every 15 minutes.

With a fixed package the electricity price stays the same for the whole contract term, exchange fluctuations do not affect the bill, and costs are easier to plan. We offer single- and dual-tariff pricing variants. With the dual-tariff variant day and night electricity consumption are metered separately. With the single-tariff variant one agreed price applies to every period of the contract. A single-tariff package suits you better if most of the electricity is consumed during the day. A dual-tariff price can be chosen if the site has a meter that measures day and night consumption separately. The day price applies Monday to Friday (except public holidays) from 07:00 to 22:00. The night price applies Monday to Friday from 22:00 to 07:00 and all day on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays.

For a long time variable pricing was considered cheaper than a fixed price, but recent experience has shown that the exchange price can just as well rise as fall, so one should be prepared for both scenarios. In a variable-price package the electricity price depends on the power exchange price. A fixed sales margin is added on top of the exchange price.
